description: KiwiRail publishes boundaries of land owned by New Zealand Railways Corporation and managed by KiwiRail. Parcels identify the nearest rail location and an accuracy category: survey accurate, verified against KiwiRail records, or unverified. NZRC properties managed by LINZ are excluded. The source combines a CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 statement with proprietary and substantial-republication restrictions. Those statements are preserved without resolving their compatibility; the dataset is not suitable for legal boundary determinations without independent verification. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source includes several reuse statements whose combined applicability remains unresolved. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
